curriculum.subject: English Language Activities
curriculum.subStrand: 9.4.1 Punctuation (capital letters, small letters and the full stop)
curriculum.outcomeText: identify capital letters, small letters, and the fullstop in a text

mission.title: identify capital letters, small letters, and the fullstop in a text

interactions.feedback: Yes! A is a capital letter.
interactions.retryHint: Look for the tall, big form of the letter.

interactions.prompt: In ‘Musa runs.’ which mark is the fullstop?
interactions.feedback: Correct! The dot at the end is a fullstop.
interactions.retryHint: Look at the very end of the sentence.

interactions.prompt: Sort each symbol into its group.
interactions.tapAlternative: Tap a symbol, then tap its group.
interactions.feedback: Perfect sorting! You found all three kinds.
interactions.retryHint: Big forms are capitals; the dot ending a sentence is a fullstop.

interactions.prompt: Read ‘The cat sleeps.’ Which is a small letter?
interactions.feedback: Right! c is a small letter.
interactions.retryHint: Choose the lowercase letter, not the first capital or the dot.

interactions.prompt: Match each item from ‘Lina plays.’ to its name.
interactions.tapAlternative: Tap an item, then tap its name.
interactions.feedback: Excellent! You can spot punctuation and letter forms in a sentence.
interactions.retryHint: Check the size and shape of each item.

interactions.prompt: Which text has a capital letter, small letters and a fullstop?
interactions.feedback: Mission complete! It begins with a capital, continues with small letters and ends with a fullstop.
interactions.retryHint: Look for all three features together.
